description: The image displays three pie charts comparing the distribution of four problem categories under a "Zero-Shot" setting across three difficulty levels labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard." A shared legend on the right identifies the four categories by color: teal for "N+K+", yellow for "N−K+", orange for "N−K−", and red for "N+K−". Each chart contains four slices, with numerical percentage labels positioned directly inside them, and no slices are visually emphasized through explosion or offset. In the "easy" chart, the segments appear ordered by descending size, with the largest slice being teal (N+K+) at 55.4%, followed by yellow (N−K+) at 38.3%, orange (N−K−) at 4.6%, and red (N+K−) at 1.7%. The "medium" chart follows the same descending size order, showing the teal slice (N+K+) at 58.8%, the yellow slice (N−K+) at 35.4%, the orange slice (N−K−) at 4.0%, and the red slice (N+K−) at 1.8%. In the "hard" chart, the size order changes, though the geometric plotting order of the categories remains consistent with the other charts; the orange slice (N−K−) is the largest at 37.9%, closely followed by the yellow slice (N−K+) at 37.3%, the teal slice (N+K+) at 18.1%, and the red slice (N+K−) at 6.7%.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of problem categories labeled as 'easy,' 'medium,' and 'hard' under Zero-Shot settings, with four segments in each chart. For the 'easy' category, the largest segment is 'N+K+' in teal, accounting for approximately 55.4%, followed by 'N−K+' in yellow at 38.3%. The 'medium' category shows a similar trend, with 'N+K+' comprising 58.8% and 'N−K+' at 35.4%. In the 'hard' category, 'N−K−' in orange is the largest segment at 47.9%, followed by 'N−K+' in yellow at 37.3%. Notably, the proportion of 'N+K−' in red remains consistent across all categories, stabilizing at around 1.7% for 'easy' and 'medium,' and increasing slightly to 6.7% for 'hard.' These charts highlight a decline in 'N+K+' as difficulty increases, while 'N−K−' exhibits a sharp rise in the 'hard' category.
